data.description:
## Description

**What**: Wire the `code-reviewer-verifier` into the CI dispatch path in `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py`. The wrapper pre-packages file contents from the reviewed SHA, re-executes the reviewer's `verification_evidence.command` independently, and routes findings by ruling.

**Why**: CI is the primary path where invalid findings cause damage — burning resolution attempts and polluting PR comments. Wiring the verifier here addresses the documented failure modes from PRs #100, #102, #103.

**Scope**:
- IN: `runner.py` dispatch wrapper changes; snapshot SHA capture at reviewer-dispatch time and propagation through reviewer → verifier → `record-review.sh`; file content pre-packaging from `<reviewed_sha>` (not live filesystem); evidence re-execution sandboxing (read-only allowlist, no network); `evidence_invalidated` flag on mismatch; finding routing by ruling (confirm/downgrade-to-minor/drop); minor findings bypass verifier
- OUT: Local /dso:review path (S5), feature flag (S6), telemetry emission (S6)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CI dispatch wrapper calls verifier between reviewer dispatch and `record-review.sh` for each critical/important/fragile finding; minor findings bypass the verifier
  ← Satisfies: "CI dispatch wrapper calls the verifier between reviewer dispatch and record-review.sh for each critical/important/fragile finding"
- When this story is complete, wrapper pre-packages cited file contents extracted from `<reviewed_sha>` (not live filesystem) and `verification_evidence` payload into verifier prompt
  ← Satisfies: "CI verifier's pre-packaged file contents are extracted from reviewed_sha"
- When this story is complete, wrapper independently re-executes `verification_evidence.command` against `<reviewed_sha>` (sandboxed: read-only allowlist, no network); compares output against `verification_evidence.output`; provides `evidence_invalidated: true` to verifier when mismatch detected; behavioral fixture: fabricated reviewer command produces no matching output and triggers drop
  ← Satisfies: "CI dispatch wrapper independently re-executes the reviewer's verification_evidence.command against reviewed_sha"
- When this story is complete, `<reviewed_sha>` is captured at reviewer-dispatch time and propagates through reviewer → verifier → `record-review.sh`; test asserts mid-review commit does not change the SHA the verifier evaluates
  ← Satisfies: "Snapshot SHA invariant: reviewed_sha is captured at reviewer-dispatch time"
- When this story is complete, verifier rulings are applied: `confirm` enters resolution loop unchanged; `downgrade-to-minor` becomes a normal minor PR comment with no resolution attempt; `drop` removes the finding before any PR-surface or resolution-loop processing
  ← Satisfies: "Verifier rulings have explicit semantics in the autonomous-resolution loop"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Security] CI re-execution of `verification_evidence.command` requires strict sandboxing — read-only allowlist, no network, to prevent command injection from malicious review findings
- [Reliability] Snapshot SHA propagation must be tested with a mid-review commit scenario to confirm it holds
- [Reliability] CI re-execution compares command output against reviewer-supplied output. Define behavior when command output legitimately varies (timestamps, absolute paths, parallel ordering): either (a) require commands to be deterministic in agent guidance (S2), (b) apply a normalization filter before comparison, or (c) treat any mismatch as evidence_invalidated: true. Document the chosen contract in S2 agent guidance.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO CI reviewer, the verifier runs between each reviewer and record-review.sh with snapshot SHA consistency and evidence re-execution
